title: eng hiring & onboarding weekly sync - 2026-04-07
content:
Attendees: Aisha Kapoor (notes), Marcus Lee, Sofia Ramirez, Ethan Chen, Priya Patel (onboarding PM)

Agenda:
- Quick headcount + hiring status
- Interview debriefs for Backend Infra and SRE candidates
- Onboarding updates for April hires + buddy assignments
- Team health flags / blockers
- Action items and next steps

1) Headcount & hiring pipeline
- Open reqs: Backend Infra (2 IC), SRE (1 senior), Frontend (1 mid), Applied ML infra (1 staff)
- Active candidates in pipeline: 14 (screening: 5, on-site/loop: 6, offer stage: 3)
- Offers: 2 outstanding (Backend IC #1, SRE senior). One verbal offer accepted (start date 2026-05-05), one pending counter off from payroll (due 2026-04-09).
- Diversity/hiring goals: continued outreach to targeted groups; Priya to share updated candidate sourcing report by EOD Friday.

2) Interview debriefs (summary notes)
- Backend Infra loop - Candidate B-22 (onsite 2026-04-06)
  - Interviewers: Marcus, Ethan, external interview (contractor)
  - Strengths: solid systems design for KV cache, good perf debugging examples, prior shipping of batching pipeline
  - Concerns: limited experience with CUDA/quantized inference stacks; unfamiliar with our kernel selection tradeoffs
  - Recommendation: strong hire for mid-senior backend role with pairing plan to upskill on GPU-side (mentor: Marcus). Score: 7/10.

- Backend Infra loop - Candidate B-23 (onsite 2026-04-06)
  - Strengths: deep C++ infra experience, ran on-prem inference clusters at previous company, strong troubleshooting
  - Concerns: cultural fit: prefers small, independent teams; quantitative metrics were vague in one interview
  - Recommendation: proceed to reference check and consider for senior IC. Score: 8/10.

- SRE loop - Candidate S-10 (onsite 2026-04-05)
  - Strengths: SLO-driven ops experience, incident leadership at scale, strong runbooks
  - Concerns: limited exposure to model-serving-specific tooling (prefers K8s-native stacks) — but learning curve acceptable
  - Recommendation: move to offer with clear expectations around on-call rotations. Score: 8/10.

Notes: Panel generally aligned on B-23 and S-10. Hiring committee to review references for S-10 and confirm comp band for B-23. Priya to schedule reference calls.

3) Onboarding sync for April starters
- New starters: 4 joining between 2026-04-20 and 2026-05-05 (Backend IC accepted, Data Infra start tentative 2026-04-27, Frontend contractor 2026-04-22, SRE accepted 2026-05-05)
- Buddy assignments: Marcus -> Backend IC, Sofia -> Data Infra, Ethan -> Frontend contractor, Aisha -> SRE onboarding lead
- Onboarding checklist (status):
  - Accounts provisioned: 2/4 done (workstations ordered for others)
  - Access to internal docs + Confluence: templates updated; onboarding doc link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ONBOARD/eng-new-hire-template
  - Ramp plan: 30/60/90 drafts created for Backend and SRE roles; need peer review by 2026-04-10
  - Trainings scheduled: infra walkthrough 2026-04-23, runtime deep-dive 2026-04-28

4) Team health & blockers
- Burn rate: small uptick this sprint due to multiple interviews and offer negotiations; team capacity feels tight for feature work in Serving Runtime (reported by Marcus)
- Ongoing blocker: environment repro for GPU memory leak in nightly canary; engineering has triaged but root cause unclear — assigned to Marcus and EngOps, target fix for 2026-04-15
- People health: two mid-level ICs flagged they are overloaded with on-call + interview panels; recommend rebalancing interview load and temporary reduction in non-critical work (status: agree)
- Cross-team dependencies: Product needs capacity for a dedicated rollout feature in May; Product PM to share priority list by 2026-04-09.

5) Admin / process / improvements
- Interview scorecard tweaks: add explicit section for "inference stack experience" and weight for production debugging; Priya to update scorecard by next week
- Candidate feedback turnaround SLA: aim for 72 hours post-loop; currently at ~96h. Recruiting to emphasize this with interviewers.
- Onboarding retro: schedule a 30-min retro after the next batch of hires complete week-1 (tentatively 2026-05-04)

6) Action items (owner -> due)
- Priya: share sourcing report + updated interview scorecard (2026-04-09)
- Marcus: lead root cause for GPU memory leak + status update (2026-04-15)
- Aisha: finalize SRE ramp plan and confirm buddy-runbook (2026-04-10)
- Hiring Committee: reference checks for S-10 and B-23 (2026-04-12)
- Recruiting: close outstanding comp discussion for Backend IC offer (2026-04-09)
- All interviewers: abide by 72h feedback SLA; recruiting to send weekly reminder (ongoing)

Misc notes / parking lot:
- Consider small stipend for interviewers (snacks / gift cards) to acknowledge panel time — Priya to propose budget
- Longer term: explore formal GPU stack onboarding workshop (Q3 goal)

Next meeting: 2026-04-14, same time.

Document owner: Aisha Kapoor
